summary:
Learning proposal to persist the user's corrections, channel details, role definition, and behavioral constraints as a new rule file. This ensures all future conversations remember:
- Channel details (Stikaman = English stickman educational, Nishchay Stories = Hindi IAS/IPS dramatic entertainment)
- Whop = clipping service for OTHER creators
- Nishchay audience doesn't buy, Stickman audience does
- Content strategy = competitor-driven
- Anti-sycophancy always active
- Mentor/manager role with daily accountability
- Schedule and constraints
- Tool preferences (no MCP calls without permission, credit awareness)
- Scripting philosophy (AI as edge, not crutch)
